text:
Rina (Growth): Quick heads-up 4e2 StratusKite confirmed a marketplace listing slot + wants a co-hosted launch webinar. Need an ops play to run: landing, webinar, benchmark blog, paid socials. Target dates: listing live 04/01, webinar 04/14, benchmark post week of 04/22. Can we map owners?
Devon (Partnerships): Great. StratusKite wants a technical deep-dive + case study. Theyre comfortable with shared registrant routing and co-branded assets.
Marco P.: two storylines to test: "inference economics" (cost/throughput) and "developer velocity" (integration & SDK). Different hero CTAs per audience.
Claire G.: routing idea 4dd Pipeline split: inbound -> form capture -> attribute -> split by ARR/employee brackets -> enterprise -> joint SDR handoff, SMB -> PLG nurture. Need webhook URL and auth header.
Evan @StratusKite: we'll provide a secure webhook and can match enterprise leads to our reps for >150 seats. Also can fund $5k for paid socials.
Rina (Growth): action list: 1) landing + registration copy (Marco) 2) webinar agenda + panel names (Devon+Evan) 3) lead routing spec + ESP A/B tests (Claire) 4) benchmark plan & datasets (Eng + Marco).
Claire G.: draft routing spec below, will iterate:
```
- event: webinar_registration
- fields: name,email,company,size_range,primary_use_case,interest_level
- rule: size_range IN ["150+","500+"] -> POST /webhooks/partners/stratuskite with header X-SK-Auth
- rule: size_range IN ["1-149"] -> SFDC queue "PLG - Redwood"
- add_tag: co-marketing_stratus_apr14
```
SamBot: reminder 514 please add final routing to partnership tracker: https://redwoodhq/partnerships/stratuskite. I can auto-post assets when unlocked.
Marco P.: benchmark scope: p50/p95 latency, cost/1k tokens, tokens/sec under 8k-token prompts; sample prompt set: chat assist, summarization, retrieval-augmented. Will publish methodology appendix.
Devon (Partnerships): panel ask: Stratus infra lead, a customer (BeaconAI suggested), our product PM. Evan to confirm BeaconAI.
Evan @StratusKite: confirming BeaconAI and webhook credentials early next week. We'll also provide creative for paid socials; Redwood does landing + blog copy.
Rina (Growth): Marketing timeline: landing live by 03/28 to allow ~2 weeks promo, email A/B test first blast 50/50. Marco to deliver two headline directions by Tue.
Marco P.: ideas: A) "Cut inference costs, not feature velocity" B) "Serve production LLMs with predictable latency". Will iterate.
Claire G.: I'll set up ESP test and UTM params: utm_source=stratuskite, utm_medium=email, campaign=stratus_apr14. Tracking in tracker doc.
Rina (Growth): nice. let's meet Fri 9am for a 20-min check. Devon, Claire, Marco, Evan please confirm. :rocket:
